title: Earlier revision at point of use
narrative: An auditor samples the instruction posted at a core process workstation. The copy shows revision 3. The document system lists revision 4 as current, approved five weeks ago. The team member says the posted copy is the one everyone uses.
evidence: Point-of-use copy: work instruction WI-210, revision 3
Document register: WI-210 revision 4, approved five weeks before the audit
No record that revision 3 was withdrawn from the workstation
Team member statement: "This is the copy we always use."
expected_action: Raise a minor nonconformity: an obsolete revision is available and in use. Correction: replace the copy and check work done since revision 4 took effect. Corrective action: find why the issue and withdrawal step failed and verify all other points of use.

title: Measuring instrument past its due date
narrative: A measuring instrument at the final check is still in daily use. Its calibration label and the calibration log both show a due date six weeks ago. Results from this instrument decide whether work items pass or fail.
evidence: Instrument label: next calibration due six weeks before the audit date
Calibration log: no calibration recorded after the due date
Check records for the last six weeks list this instrument for pass or fail decisions
No assessment of the validity of earlier results
expected_action: Raise a major nonconformity: results that decide release depend on an instrument with no valid calibration status. Correction: remove the instrument from use, calibrate it, and assess the validity of results since the due date. Corrective action: fix the recall system so due dates cannot be missed.

title: New team member with no qualification record
narrative: A team member who joined three weeks ago is performing a task that the training matrix marks as qualified-only. No qualification record exists for this person, and no supervised sign-off is recorded. The supervisor states that the person learned by watching a colleague.
evidence: Training matrix: task marked "qualified persons only"
No qualification or supervised training record for the new team member
Work records show the person signed for the task on 11 occasions
Supervisor statement: "They picked it up by watching."
expected_action: Raise a minor nonconformity: competence for the task is not shown by evidence. Correction: assess the person and record the result; review the work already done. Corrective action: make the induction process prevent unqualified task assignment.

title: Input accepted without verification
narrative: An externally provided input is booked into stock and released to use on the day it arrives. The receiving procedure requires a check against the purchase specification. The receiving record has no entry for that check.
evidence: Receiving procedure: verification against specification required before release to use
Receiving record: date and quantity filled in; verification column blank
Input already used on two work items
Receiving clerk statement: "The provider is reliable, so we skip it when we are busy."
expected_action: Raise a minor nonconformity: externally provided input was not verified as planned. Correction: verify the remaining input and evaluate the work items that used it. Corrective action: make the verification step a condition for release to use.

title: Process setting changed with no change record
narrative: A process owner changed a key process setting to increase output. There is no change request, no review of the effect on conformity, and no approval. Two days later, defect rates rose at the next stage.
evidence: Process parameter sheet: current value differs from the approved value
No change request or review record for the new value
Defect log shows a rise beginning two days after the change
Process owner statement: "It was a small adjustment."
expected_action: Raise a major nonconformity: an uncontrolled change affected conformity. Correction: restore the approved setting and contain affected work items. Corrective action: require review, approval, and a record for every change to approved process settings.

title: Two customers' items held together
narrative: At the handover area, items for two different customers are held on the same shelf without separation. Neither group carries a label or system status that shows which customer it belongs to. The team member identifies them from memory.
evidence: Observation: two customers' items on one shelf, no divider
No identification label or system status for either group
Handover instruction requires identification by customer and order
Team member statement: "I know which is which."
expected_action: Raise a minor nonconformity: outputs and customer property are not identified and kept apart. Correction: identify and separate the items now. Corrective action: provide marked locations and make identification part of the handover check.

title: Release with an open discrepancy
narrative: A work item was released to the customer while a discrepancy raised at the final check was still open. No person with release authority signed a concession or an authorization. The release was made to meet a promised delivery date.
evidence: Final check record: discrepancy noted, status "open"
Release record: released on the same day
No concession, deviation, or authorization signature
Delivery schedule shows the promised date was that day
expected_action: Raise a major nonconformity: release took place before the planned arrangements were complete and without authorization. Correction: inform the customer and contain the released work item. Corrective action: block release in the record or system while any discrepancy is open.

title: Held work item with no flag or disposition
narrative: A work item was placed on hold nine days ago after a suspected defect. It carries no hold flag and no system hold status, and no disposition has been decided. It sits next to items that are ready for release.
evidence: Nonconformance log entry dated nine days before the audit; disposition column blank
No hold flag on the work item; system status shows "in process"
Item located beside conforming items awaiting release
Procedure requires disposition within five working days
expected_action: Raise a minor nonconformity: a nonconforming output is not identified or controlled against unintended use. Correction: flag and segregate the item and decide its disposition. Corrective action: review the hold log daily and escalate overdue dispositions.

title: Corrective action closed without effectiveness check
narrative: A corrective action for a repeat defect was closed one week after the action was taken. The record has no effectiveness check. The same defect appears again in the following month's data.
evidence: Corrective action record: action taken and closed; effectiveness field blank
Closure signed one week after action
Defect data for the following month shows two repeat occurrences
Procedure requires an effectiveness check before closure
expected_action: Raise a minor nonconformity: the effectiveness of the corrective action was not reviewed. Correction: reopen the action. Corrective action: require defined effectiveness criteria and a review date before closure is possible.

title: Internal audit of a key process skipped
narrative: The internal audit program planned an audit of a key process in the second quarter. The audit did not take place and no reason or new date is recorded. That process had the highest number of complaints last year.
evidence: Audit program: key process audit planned for the second quarter
Audit status: "not done"; no reason or rescheduled date
Complaint summary: the same process had the most complaints last year
No audit report for this process in the last 18 months
expected_action: Raise a minor nonconformity: the audit program was not carried out as planned and gave no weight to process importance. Correction: schedule the audit. Corrective action: review program status monthly and record reasons for any change.

title: Management review with no actions or owners
narrative: The management review minutes record a discussion of performance data and two customer complaints. The minutes contain no decisions, actions, owners, or dates. Managers say actions were agreed verbally.
evidence: Management review minutes: inputs discussed, outputs section empty
No action list, owners, or due dates
Manager statement: "We agreed what to do in the room."
No follow-up item in the next meeting agenda
expected_action: Record an observation: review outputs are not shown, which risks lost actions. Recommend that every review records decisions, actions, owners, and dates. The certification body may classify this differently if outputs are wholly missing.

title: Condition alarm with no response record
narrative: A monitored condition in the work area (temperature, cleanliness, system availability, or similar) triggered an alarm last week. The alarm is in the monitoring log. There is no record of who responded, what was checked, or whether work items were affected.
evidence: Monitoring log: alarm recorded with date and time
Response column blank
No assessment of work items processed during the alarm period
Instruction requires a recorded response within one hour
expected_action: Raise a minor nonconformity: the environment needed for conforming work was not maintained or shown to be maintained. Correction: assess affected work items. Corrective action: assign alarm response roles and make the response record mandatory.

title: Updated customer requirement not passed on
narrative: A customer sent an updated requirement four weeks ago, and sales accepted it. The delivery team still works to the old requirement because the change was never communicated or added to the work documents. Three deliveries have since been made to the old requirement.
evidence: Customer correspondence: revised requirement accepted four weeks before the audit
Work documents in use: old requirement
Three deliveries since acceptance made to the old requirement
No record that relevant people were told of the change
expected_action: Raise a major nonconformity: changed requirements did not reach the people doing the work and nonconforming outputs were delivered. Correction: update the documents and inform the customer about the three deliveries. Corrective action: define a requirement change process with confirmation by each affected team.

title: Approved provider list out of date
narrative: The approved provider list was last updated 14 months ago. One provider's annual evaluation is four months overdue, and a new provider in regular use does not appear on the list at all.
evidence: Approved provider list: last revision 14 months ago
Evaluation record for one provider: due four months ago, not done
Purchase orders to a provider not on the list
Procedure requires annual evaluation and listing before first use
expected_action: Raise a minor nonconformity: provider evaluation and approval are not maintained as planned. Correction: evaluate the overdue and the unlisted provider. Corrective action: link purchasing to the approved list and track evaluation due dates.

title: Damaged customer property, customer not told
narrative: Material, equipment, or data supplied by the customer arrived damaged or incomplete. The receiving team noted the damage on the delivery note but did not inform the customer. The property was used in the work anyway.
evidence: Delivery note: "packaging damaged, one unit missing"
No record of communication to the customer
Work record shows the property was used
Customer property procedure requires notification of loss or damage
expected_action: Raise a minor nonconformity: loss or damage to customer property was not reported to the customer. Correction: inform the customer now and agree on disposition. Corrective action: add a mandatory notification step at receiving.

title: Training matrix current and confirmed
narrative: The auditor compares the training matrix with the people on shift. Every task performed has a matching qualification record. Interviews show that team members can explain the key steps and what to do when something goes wrong.
evidence: Training matrix revised last month; all names on shift present
Qualification records signed by an assessor for each task observed
Three interviews: each person explained the key steps and the stop and report rule
Refresher dates scheduled
expected_action: No finding. Record the scenario as conforming evidence in the audit notes and do not raise a nonconformity or an observation without a gap.

title: Instruments in date; out-of-tolerance event handled
narrative: All sampled instruments are within their calibration dates. One instrument was found out of tolerance at its last calibration. The record shows an assessment of earlier results, the work items checked, and the decision taken.
evidence: Calibration log: all sampled instruments within date
Out-of-tolerance report with an impact assessment
List of work items rechecked and the result
Decision approved by the quality lead
expected_action: No finding. Record the scenario as conforming evidence in the audit notes and do not raise a nonconformity or an observation without a gap.

title: Document control working
narrative: The auditor checks five points of use against the document register. All copies are the current revision. The revision history explains each change, and obsolete copies are stamped and archived.
evidence: Five point-of-use copies match the register
Revision history entries describe each change and approval
Obsolete copies stamped "superseded" in a controlled archive
No personal notes or uncontrolled copies found
expected_action: No finding. Record the scenario as conforming evidence in the audit notes and do not raise a nonconformity or an observation without a gap.

title: Handover checklist complete
narrative: The handover checklist for the sampled work item is signed at each step. The label or confirmation was verified against the order and the verification is recorded. The packaging or handover method matches the instruction.
evidence: Handover checklist signed with date and name at each step
Label or confirmation check recorded against the order
Packaging or handover method matches the instruction
Record retrievable within two minutes
expected_action: No finding. Record the scenario as conforming evidence in the audit notes and do not raise a nonconformity or an observation without a gap.

title: Complaint handled from end to end
narrative: A customer complaint was logged on the day it arrived. Affected work items were contained, the root cause was identified, and actions were taken. An effectiveness check three months later found no repeat and the customer confirmed satisfaction.
evidence: Complaint log entry with date, customer, and description
Containment record listing affected work items
Root cause analysis and action plan with owners
Effectiveness check: no repeat in three months; customer feedback recorded
expected_action: No finding. Record the scenario as conforming evidence in the audit notes and do not raise a nonconformity or an observation without a gap.

title: Records filled in before the work
narrative: At the start of a shift the auditor sees check sheets for the whole shift already completed with "pass" entries. The checks they describe have not yet been performed. The team member says it saves time at the end of the shift.
evidence: Check sheet: entries for times later in the day already marked "pass"
Time of observation: start of shift
Team member statement: "We fill them in early to save time."
Instruction requires recording at the time of the check
expected_action: Raise a major nonconformity: records do not reflect controlled conditions, so the results of monitoring cannot be trusted. Correction: void the pre-filled entries and perform the checks. Corrective action: address the cause, such as time pressure or record design, and reinforce recording at the time of the activity.

title: Known risk with no action
narrative: The risk register lists a single-source input as a high risk. No action, owner, or review date is recorded. Last quarter a delay from that source stopped work for two days.
evidence: Risk register: single-source input rated high
Action, owner, and review columns blank
Production log: two-day stoppage last quarter linked to that source
Register last reviewed 11 months ago
expected_action: Raise a minor nonconformity: actions to address an identified risk were not planned. Correction: assign an owner and action. Corrective action: review the register at a set frequency and link it to management review.

title: Objective with no recent data
narrative: A quality objective for on-time delivery was set at the start of the year. The objectives board shows no data for the last two quarters. The owner cannot say whether the target is being met.
evidence: Objectives board: target set in January
No results recorded for the last two quarters
Owner statement: "We stopped updating it."
Management review minutes do not mention the objective
expected_action: Raise a minor nonconformity: progress on a quality objective is not monitored. Correction: collect and post current data. Corrective action: assign data owners and review objectives at a set frequency.

title: Team member unaware of consequences
narrative: When asked, a team member cannot describe the quality policy in any form. The person also cannot say what happens to the customer if a check in their step is skipped. Induction records show awareness training was planned but not delivered.
evidence: Interview: unable to describe the policy or the effect of skipping a check
Induction plan lists awareness session; no attendance record
Team member started four months ago
Policy is posted in the area
expected_action: Raise a minor nonconformity: people doing the work are not aware of the policy and of the effect of not following requirements. Correction: deliver the awareness session. Corrective action: make awareness training part of induction sign-off.

title: Known issue lost at shift handover
narrative: The day shift found a fault in a piece of equipment and worked around it. The fault was not passed to the night shift, which produced four work items with the same defect. The handover log has no entry about the fault.
evidence: Day shift notes: fault noticed and workaround used
Shift handover log: no mention of the fault
Night shift: four work items with the related defect
No defined content for shift handover
expected_action: Raise a minor nonconformity: internal communication of a relevant issue was not effective. Correction: contain the four work items. Corrective action: define what must be communicated at shift handover and how it is recorded.

title: Preventive maintenance overdue
narrative: The maintenance plan shows that preventive maintenance on a key piece of equipment is three months overdue. The equipment has had two unplanned stoppages since. No one has assessed the effect on work item quality.
evidence: Maintenance plan: task due three months ago, status open
Breakdown log: two stoppages since the due date
No assessment of effect on conformity
Maintenance staff statement: "We have not had the parts or the time."
expected_action: Raise a minor nonconformity: infrastructure is not maintained as planned. Correction: perform the maintenance and assess recent output. Corrective action: resource the maintenance plan and escalate overdue tasks.

title: Know-how held by one person
narrative: Only one experienced team member knows how to set up a critical process step. The method is not written down, and no one else has been trained. When that person was on leave last month, the step was delayed for a week.
evidence: No instruction or knowledge record for the setup
Training matrix: one qualified person only
Delivery log: one-week delay during leave
No plan to capture or share the knowledge
expected_action: Record an observation: needed knowledge is held by one person and is at risk. Recommend capturing the method, training a second person, and recording lessons learned. Classification may rise if conformity is affected.

title: Order accepted without review
narrative: An order with a shorter-than-usual delivery date was accepted by a salesperson. There is no record that the delivery team confirmed it could meet the date before acceptance. The order was delivered late.
evidence: Order confirmation sent the day the enquiry arrived
No review record or sign-off from the delivery team
Delivery record: two weeks late
Procedure requires a capacity check before accepting non-standard dates
expected_action: Raise a minor nonconformity: requirements were not reviewed before committing to the customer. Correction: inform the customer and agree on a revised date. Corrective action: make the review a condition for order confirmation.

title: Design change released without verification
narrative: A design change was released to the delivery team without a design review or verification record. The change affected how a work item is checked. Two customers have since reported problems linked to the change.
evidence: Design change notice: released, approver signature present
No review, verification, or validation record for the change
Two complaints linked to the changed feature
Design procedure requires verification before release
expected_action: Raise a major nonconformity: design changes were not reviewed and verified before release. Correction: verify the change and contain affected outputs. Corrective action: enforce design change control with required records before release.

title: Work items with no status
narrative: In the core process area, several work items have no label or system status. The team cannot say which items have passed the in-process check and which have not. Two of the items are later found to be untested.
evidence: Observation: six work items with no label or status
Team member unable to state check status
Two items later found untested
Instruction requires status identification after each check
expected_action: Raise a minor nonconformity: the status of outputs with respect to checks is not identified. Correction: identify and check the six items. Corrective action: make status labels or system status part of each check step.

title: Stored outside required conditions
narrative: Work items waiting for delivery are stored in an area that does not meet the conditions in the storage instruction. Some packaging is damaged. The storage condition record has not been completed for two weeks.
evidence: Storage instruction: specified conditions and handling method
Observation: items stacked above the stated limit; damaged packaging
Storage condition record blank for two weeks
Team statement: "The proper area is full."
expected_action: Raise a minor nonconformity: outputs are not preserved as required. Correction: move and inspect the items. Corrective action: plan storage capacity and restore condition monitoring.

title: Support request not logged
narrative: A customer asked for support with a delivered work item under the agreed warranty or service terms. The request was received by phone but never logged. The customer chased twice and received no response for three weeks.
evidence: Customer email: second reminder after three weeks
No entry in the post-delivery or support log
Service terms require response within five working days
Staff member recalls the call but did not record it
expected_action: Raise a minor nonconformity: post-delivery activities were not carried out as required. Correction: respond to the customer. Corrective action: require logging of every support request at first contact.

title: Data collected but not analyzed
narrative: The team records rework counts every day. Nobody reviews the data. A chart drawn by the auditor shows rework doubling over three months, which no one had noticed.
evidence: Daily rework counts recorded for three months
No analysis, trend chart, or review record
Auditor's chart: rework doubled over the period
Not included in management review inputs
expected_action: Record an observation: data is collected but not analyzed and evaluated. Recommend a monthly trend review and feeding the results into management review. Classification may rise if decisions were affected.

title: No view of customer perception
narrative: The only customer information collected is the complaint log. There is no method to understand how satisfied customers are. Managers believe satisfaction is high because complaints are few.
evidence: Complaint log is the only customer data source
No survey, feedback review, or other perception method
Manager statement: "No complaints means they are happy."
Management review inputs do not include customer satisfaction
expected_action: Raise a minor nonconformity: customer perception is not monitored. Correction: define a feedback method. Corrective action: include customer satisfaction results in management review.

title: Unclear release authority
narrative: Two supervisors give different answers about who may approve a concession to release a work item with a minor discrepancy. The role descriptions do not mention release authority. One concession was approved by a person who believed they had the authority.
evidence: Role descriptions: no reference to release or concession authority
Two supervisors give conflicting answers
One concession record signed by a team lead
No authority matrix found
expected_action: Raise a minor nonconformity: responsibilities and authorities for release are not assigned and communicated. Correction: review the concession. Corrective action: publish an authority matrix and brief all supervisors.

title: Scope leaves out a performed process
narrative: The scope statement of the quality management system says the organization does not perform design. The auditor finds that the team designs custom solutions for some customers. No justification for the exclusion is recorded.
evidence: Scope statement: design excluded
Customer files show custom design work for three customers
No justification for the exclusion
Design work has no planned controls
expected_action: Raise a minor nonconformity: the scope does not reflect the activities performed. Correction: review the scope statement. Corrective action: apply design controls to the custom work or justify the boundary.

title: Reworked item not rechecked
narrative: A work item that failed the final check was reworked and released the same day. There is no record that it was checked again after the rework. The nonconformance log shows the disposition as "reworked, closed".
evidence: Nonconformance log: disposition "rework"; status closed
No re-check record after rework
Release record: same day
Procedure requires re-verification after correction
expected_action: Raise a major nonconformity: a corrected output was released without verification of conformity. Correction: recheck or recall the item. Corrective action: make re-verification a required step before closing a rework disposition.

title: Corrective action treats the symptom
narrative: A customer complained about the same problem for the third time this year. Each corrective action record shows only a correction such as "item replaced". No cause analysis was carried out.
evidence: Three complaint records on the same problem this year
Each corrective action record: correction only
Cause analysis field blank in all three
Procedure requires a cause analysis for repeat complaints
expected_action: Raise a minor nonconformity: causes were not determined, so the problem recurs. Correction: start a cause analysis now. Corrective action: require cause analysis before a corrective action can be closed.

title: Policy understood in the work area
narrative: The quality policy is displayed in the work area. Four team members, interviewed separately, explain in their own words what the policy means for their work. The policy was reviewed at the last management review.
evidence: Policy displayed at the entrance and on the team board
Four interviews: each person gave a clear explanation in their own words
Management review minutes: policy reviewed and confirmed
Policy included in induction material
expected_action: No finding. Record the scenario as conforming evidence in the audit notes and do not raise a nonconformity or an observation without a gap.

title: Release authorized and traceable
narrative: The auditor traces a delivered work item back from the delivery record. The final check results are recorded, the release was signed by a named person with release authority, and the record links to the work item identifier.
evidence: Delivery record links to the work item identifier
Final check results recorded with date and name
Release signature from a person listed in the authority matrix
Record retrieved within three minutes
expected_action: No finding. Record the scenario as conforming evidence in the audit notes and do not raise a nonconformity or an observation without a gap.

title: Hold area under control
narrative: All held work items carry a hold flag or system hold status and sit in a marked hold location. Each has a disposition recorded within the target time, and the person who decided is named.
evidence: Hold area marked and separated
Each held item flagged or system status "hold"
Nonconformance log: dispositions recorded within target time
Decision makers named
expected_action: No finding. Record the scenario as conforming evidence in the audit notes and do not raise a nonconformity or an observation without a gap.

title: Customer told of a delay in time
narrative: A delivery was going to be late because of an input shortage. The customer was informed two days before the due date, as the contract requires. The record shows the message, the customer's reply, and the agreed new date.
evidence: Customer communication log: message sent two days before the due date
Customer reply accepting the new date
Order record updated with the agreed date
Contract term on delay notification met
expected_action: No finding. Record the scenario as conforming evidence in the audit notes and do not raise a nonconformity or an observation without a gap.

title: Operating limits not at point of use
narrative: A process step has defined operating limits, but they are not available at the workstation. The team member works from memory and gives a value that differs from the approved limit. No record of the actual values is kept.
evidence: Approved process sheet lists the operating limits
No copy or system display at the workstation
Team member states a value outside the approved limit
No record of actual values for the shift
expected_action: Raise a minor nonconformity: the information needed for controlled conditions is not available. Correction: provide the limits at the workstation. Corrective action: check all steps for point-of-use information and records.

title: Improvement ideas not reviewed
narrative: An improvement suggestion box and an online form are in place. Thirty-one suggestions have been received in twelve months. None has been reviewed or answered.
evidence: Suggestion log: 31 entries, all with status "new"
No review meeting or decision record
Team members say they stopped making suggestions
Management review does not mention improvement ideas
expected_action: Record an observation: a source of improvement is not used. Recommend a regular review of suggestions with feedback to the people who made them.

title: Outsourced step with no controls
narrative: One process step is performed by an external provider. Work returned from the provider goes straight to the next stage with no check. Nobody has defined what controls apply to this outsourced step.
evidence: Process map shows an outsourced step
No defined verification for returned work
Provider not on the approved provider list
Three returns last quarter had defects found by the customer
expected_action: Raise a major nonconformity: an externally provided process is not controlled and nonconforming outputs reached the customer. Correction: verify work returned from the provider. Corrective action: define controls, evaluate the provider, and add it to the approved list.

title: Workload change made without planning
narrative: Management added a second product line to an existing team without assessing capacity or the effect on the existing work. Overtime rose and the on-time rate fell from 96 to 81 percent. No change plan or review exists.
evidence: No change plan or capacity assessment for the new line
Overtime records: 40 percent increase
On-time delivery: 96 percent before, 81 percent after
Management review minutes do not mention the change
expected_action: Raise a minor nonconformity: a change to the management system was not planned. Correction: assess capacity now. Corrective action: require a change plan covering purpose, resources, and responsibilities for significant changes.

title: Machining to a superseded drawing
narrative: At Meridian Works an operator machines a batch to drawing revision B. Revision C, which changed one dimension, was released two weeks ago. The revision B print is pinned at the machine.
evidence: Drawing at the machine: revision B
Document register: revision C released two weeks before the audit
Two batches machined since the release
No withdrawal record for revision B
expected_action: Raise a minor nonconformity. Correction: replace the drawing and inspect the two batches against revision C. Corrective action: link drawing release to withdrawal of old prints at every machine.

title: Torque wrench past its calibration date
narrative: A torque wrench used for final assembly checks at Meridian Works is past its calibration date by five weeks. It has been used on every batch since. No assessment of the results has been made.
evidence: Torque wrench label: calibration due five weeks ago
Calibration log: no later entry
Assembly records: wrench used on 14 batches since the due date
No impact assessment
expected_action: Raise a major nonconformity. Correction: quarantine the tool, calibrate it, and assess the 14 batches. Corrective action: introduce a recall list with automatic alerts before due dates.

title: Free-issue components mixed with own stock
narrative: Free-issue components supplied by a customer are stored in the same bins as Meridian Works' own stock. The bins carry no customer label. Stock counts cannot show how many customer components remain.
evidence: Observation: customer and own components in shared bins
No customer identification on the bins
Stock system has no separate location for customer property
Customer property procedure requires separate, labeled storage
expected_action: Raise a minor nonconformity. Correction: separate, count, and label the customer components. Corrective action: create a controlled location for customer property.

title: Material certificate not checked
narrative: Bar stock arrives at Meridian Works with a material certificate. The receiving inspector books the material in without checking the certificate against the heat lot number on the bars. The material is already in the saw queue.
evidence: Receiving record: certificate filed; check box blank
Heat lot on the bars not recorded
Material issued to cutting the same day
Receiving instruction requires a certificate-to-lot check
expected_action: Raise a minor nonconformity. Correction: verify the certificate against the bars before further use. Corrective action: make the check a condition for booking material in.

title: Pack-out checklist complete
narrative: The pack-out checklist for a batch leaving Meridian Works is signed at every step. Label details were verified against the order and the verification is recorded. Packaging matches the customer's packing instruction.
evidence: Pack-out checklist signed and dated
Label verification against the order recorded
Packaging matches the instruction
Record linked to the batch number
expected_action: No finding. Record the scenario as conforming evidence in the audit notes and do not raise a nonconformity or an observation without a gap.

title: Earlier label artwork on the packaging line
narrative: At Meridian Foods the packaging line runs with label artwork revision 5. Revision 6, which corrected the ingredient order, was approved last week. The old reels were not removed from the line store.
evidence: Label reel on the line: artwork revision 5
Artwork register: revision 6 approved last week
Old reels still in the line store
Two production batches packed since approval
expected_action: Raise a minor nonconformity. Correction: stop the line, remove revision 5 reels, and evaluate the two batches. Corrective action: link artwork approval to removal of obsolete reels.

title: Temperature probe not verified
narrative: A temperature probe used to confirm processing at Meridian Foods has not been verified in the required monthly interval. The last verification was eleven weeks ago. Release decisions depend on its readings.
evidence: Verification log: last entry eleven weeks ago; monthly interval required
Probe readings used for release decisions
No impact assessment for batches in the period
Verification instruction available
expected_action: Raise a major nonconformity. Correction: verify the probe and assess the batches processed in the period. Corrective action: schedule verifications with alerts and a backup probe.

title: Customer packaging unidentified
narrative: Private label packaging supplied by a customer is stored in the Meridian Foods warehouse without any identification. It sits beside the company's own packaging of similar appearance.
evidence: Observation: customer packaging on unlabeled pallets
Similar own-brand packaging on the next pallet
No location record for the customer packaging
Customer property procedure requires identification
expected_action: Raise a minor nonconformity. Correction: identify and separate the customer packaging. Corrective action: label customer property at receipt and assign marked locations.

title: Batch released before laboratory result
